uncached_input_tokens.title: Uncached Input Tokens
uncached_input_tokens.description: The number of uncached input tokens processed.

cache_creation.description: The number of input tokens for cache creation.

cache_read_input_tokens.title: Cache Read Input Tokens
cache_read_input_tokens.description: The number of input tokens read from the cache.

output_tokens.title: Output Tokens
output_tokens.description: The number of output tokens generated.

api_key_id.title: Api Key Id
api_key_id.description: ID of the API key used. `null` if not grouping by API key or if the request did not use an API key, as with usage in the Claude Console or from most Claude Managed Agents sessions.

workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
workspace_id.description: ID of the Workspace used. `null` if not grouping by workspace or for the default workspace.

account_id.title: Account Id
account_id.description: ID of the user account that made the request. `null` if not grouping by account or if no user account made the request.

service_account_id.title: Service Account Id
service_account_id.description: ID of the service account that made the request. `null` if not grouping by service account or if no service account made the request. This can be the ID of an Anthropic-managed service account, such as one that runs Claude Managed Agents sessions, which the Service Accounts endpoints do not return.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model used. `null` if not grouping by model.

service_tier.description: Service tier used. `null` if not grouping by service tier.

context_window.description:
Context window used. `null` if not grouping by context window.

A request is classified by comparing its prompt size with its model's own long-context boundary, the same boundary that billing uses. The two values are labels for the two classes, not literal ranges: where a model's boundary is below 200k, a request whose prompt exceeds that boundary is reported under `200k-1M`, and a `0-200k` filter does not return it. Where the report cannot determine a model's boundary, it uses 200k instead. Usage stored before this classification took effect may still be reported under its earlier value, at any `bucket_width`, until it expires. Billed amounts are not affected.

inference_geo.title: Inference Geo
inference_geo.description:
Inference geo used matching requests' `inference_geo` parameter if set, otherwise the workspace's `default_inference_geo`.
For models that do not support specifying `inference_geo` the value is `"not_available"`. Always `null` if not grouping by inference geo.

speed.description: Speed of the usage. `null` if not grouping by speed.
